extracted.intended_audience: general newspaper readers interested in international and political affairs
extracted.subtask_description: A wire-service newspaper dispatch (multiple items) reporting on mid-20th-century international affairs, including United Nations procedural items, British domestic politics, and Dutch–Indonesian military operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Items may be added to or deleted from the agenda
rubrics_metrics.description: Items may be added to or deleted from the agenda by a majority of the members present and voting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is given as the procedural rule governing amendment of the Assembly agenda (original wording: 'Items may be added to or deleted from the agenda-by a majority of the mem present and voting'). No additional scoring guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption of the agenda
rubrics_metrics.description: Adoption of the agenda is a formal step of the Assembly (noted as 'Adoption of the: nda' in text).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears as a procedural line item; adoption is indicated as an item to be taken up (originally 'Adoption 4 by ... the number of conference rooms').

rubrics_metrics.name: Election of six members of the Economic and Social Council
rubrics_metrics.description: Election of six members of the Economic and Social Council (the Council consists of eighteen nations, serving for three years).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a specific election item on the Assembly agenda; context notes council membership size and term length (three years).

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal to increase Economic and Social Council membership to twenty-four
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals to increase the membership of the Economic and Social Council to twenty-four.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a suggested change to council composition; included alongside other organizational/administrative proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assembly barred from considering matters dealt with by the Security Council
rubrics_metrics.description: The Assembly is barred from considering such items when matters relative to the maintenance of international peace and security are being dealt with by the Security Council.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural limitation on Assembly jurisdiction referenced in the text ('The Assembly is barred from considering such items'). This is a rule of procedure rather than an editorial guideline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous interpretation / conference-room equipage
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase the number of conference rooms equipped with simultaneous interpretation apparatus for Assembly plenary session and some committees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentioned as an administrative/practical recommendation to support multilingual deliberations (original wording references 'translation in Assembly plenary session and some committees—but for an increase in the number of conference rooms equipped with simultaneous interpretation apparatus').

rubrics_metrics.name: Election of three non-permanent members of the Security Council
rubrics_metrics.description: Election of three non-permanent members of the Security Council (terms of Australia, Brazil and Poland expire at the end of 1947; replacements to be elected).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a scheduled electoral item with note of expiring terms and which seats are to be filled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational and administrative matters (committees and reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Organizational and administrative matters including: (a) advisory committee, (b) committee on contributions/continuance of present practices, (c) board of auditors, and reporting to the next session.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collected under a single agenda heading in the text; includes subitems and the expectation of committee reports and administrative oversight functions ('Organizational and administrative matters. (a) ... (b) ... (c) board of auditors. ... report to the next session').

rubrics_metrics.name: Report of the United Nations Benefit Committee / joint staff pension schemes
rubrics_metrics.description: Report of the United Nations Benefit Committee and matters concerning joint staff pension schemes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cited alongside related administrative resolutions (original references: 'Report of thé United Nations Benefit Committee' and 'joint staff pension schemes'; associated resolution/date references appear in the text).
